name: Image Vision Bridge
description: Bridge local Ollama vision models into text-only AI assistants. When an image appears in conversation and the current model lacks native vision, this skill automatically describes the image in text — no model switching required.
description_zh: 本地视觉模型桥接——当对话中出现图片而当前模型不支持多模态时，自动调用本地 Ollama 视觉模型（qwen3.5:4b）读取图片并用文字描述返回，无需切换模型。
